thresher.note: 1-2: a heavy hauler with cutters in front, no parts.
thresher.name: THRESHER

prowler.note: 1-3: a raider with swept wings, no parts.
prowler.name: PROWLER

pulsar.note: 1-4: a ring-shaped pulse ship, no parts: rings.
pulsar.name: PULSAR

rockbreaker.note: 1-5: a mining ship with two drills; armored until they're gone.
rockbreaker.name: ROCKBREAKER

warden.note: 1-6, Highlands' boss: a battle station, no parts, two phases by health.
warden.name: WARDEN

cyclone.note: 2-2: a ring ship spinning its guns, no parts: spirals, three phases.
cyclone.name: CYCLONE

siege_pod.note: 2-3: an armored siege ship, no parts, three phases on its health.
siege_pod.name: SIEGE POD

delta_raider.note: 2-4: a delta-winged raider, no parts: sweeping fans, three phases.
delta_raider.name: DELTA RAIDER

breacher.note: 2-5: an assault ship with two breaching clamps; armored until they're gone.
breacher.name: BREACHER

harvester.note: 2-6, Wildwood's boss: two cannons; the core is armored until both are gone.
harvester.name: HARVESTER

turbine.note: 3-1: a ship built around a spinning turbine, no parts: spirals, three phases.
turbine.name: TURBINE

clamp_barge.note: 3-2: a barge with two clamps; armored until they're gone.
clamp_barge.name: CLAMP BARGE

spire.note: 3-3: a tall command ship, no parts, three phases on its health.
spire.name: SPIRE

twin_fang.note: 3-4: two side guns that can be left alive: the core isn't armored.
twin_fang.name: TWIN FANG

frigate.note: 3-5: a frigate with two deck guns; armored until they're gone.
frigate.name: FRIGATE

tidebreaker.note: 3-6, Lush Veld's boss: two missile batteries, then two phases of the core alone.
tidebreaker.name: TIDEBREAKER

picket.note: 4-1: a picket ship with two gun pods; armored until they're gone.
picket.name: PICKET

bulwark.note: 4-2: an armored ship with two rams in front; armored until they're gone.
bulwark.name: BULWARK

borer.note: 4-3: a boring ship with two generators; armored until they're gone.
borer.name: BORER

silo_hauler.note: 4-4: a hauler with two fuel tanks; armored until they're gone.
silo_hauler.name: SILO HAULER

bastion.note: 4-5: a fortress ship with two turrets; armored until they're gone.
bastion.name: BASTION

reaper.note: 4-6, Heartland's boss: a giant harvester: augers and a cutter in front, then two drills at the back.
reaper.name: REAPER

enforcer.note: 5-1: an enforcer behind two armor shields (they don't shoot); armored until they're gone.
enforcer.name: ENFORCER

hive_carrier.note: 5-2: a carrier with two hangars; armored, then two phases on its health.
hive_carrier.name: HIVE CARRIER

hover_tank.note: 5-3: a heavy gunboat with two turrets; armored until they're gone.
hover_tank.name: HOVER TANK

cryo_fortress.note: 5-4: a fortress ship with two cryo cannons; armored until they're gone.
cryo_fortress.name: CRYO FORTRESS

sentry_grid.note: 5-5: a sentry ship with four nodes: the outer pair, then the inner pair, then the core.
sentry_grid.name: SENTRY GRID

leviathan.note: 5-6, Rust Pan's boss: a battleship: turrets and flank nodes, then the reactors at the stern, then the core.
leviathan.name: LEVIATHAN

relay_array.note: 6-1: a relay station with two dishes; armored until they're gone.
relay_array.name: RELAY ARRAY

scavenger.note: 6-2: a salvager with two wing batteries; armored, then two phases.
scavenger.name: SCAVENGER

mine_carrier.note: 6-3: a mine carrier with two launchers; armored, then two phases on its health.
mine_carrier.name: MINE CARRIER

foundry.note: 6-4: a foundry ship with two presses; armored, then two phases on its health.
foundry.name: FOUNDRY

gunship_prime.note: 6-5: a heavy gunship with two cannons and two engines: cannons, then engines, then the core.
gunship_prime.name: GUNSHIP PRIME

colossus.note: 6-6, Bright Ridges' boss: four turrets, the outer pair first, then the inner pair, then the core.
colossus.name: COLOSSUS

grappler.note: 7-1: a salvage ship with four grapples; armored until they're all gone, then two phases.
grappler.name: GRAPPLER

tugmaster.note: 7-2: a space tug with two thrusters and a ram plate: thrusters, then the plate, then the core.
tugmaster.name: TUGMASTER

magma_rig.note: 7-3: a mining rig with two furnaces and two cannons: furnaces, then cannons, then the core.
magma_rig.name: MAGMA RIG

dreadnought.note: 7-4: a battleship with four turrets and a bow gun: turrets, then the bow gun, then the core.
dreadnought.name: DREADNOUGHT

flare_rig.note: 7-5: a flare rig: two gun pods in front, two missile launchers behind them and two flak towers.
flare_rig.name: FLARE RIG

crucible.note: 7-6, Ironworks' boss: a smelting block: two furnaces on deck, two beacons at the bow; armored, then two phases.
crucible.name: CRUCIBLE

executor.note: 8-1: a command ship with two generators and two blades; armored, then two phases on its health.
executor.name: EXECUTOR

interdictor.note: 8-2: an interceptor carrier: two bow cannons, two sensor dishes on its wings; armored until the dishes go.
interdictor.name: INTERDICTOR

nightwatch.note: 8-3: a gunboat: two turrets on deck and two guns on its flanks; turrets, then guns, then the core.
nightwatch.name: NIGHTWATCH

arc_tower.note: 8-4: a power station: two arc emitters at the bow and two nodes on deck; armored, then two phases.
arc_tower.name: ARC TOWER

apex.note: 8-5: a flagship: two heavy cannons on its wings and two beam emitters at the stern; armored, then two phases.
apex.name: APEX

overmind.note: 8-6, Metropolis' boss: shield generators armor the core; cannons on the sides keep firing.
overmind.name: OVERMIND
